name: Embassy
description: A hall for foreign dispatch and reception. Each tier lets the guild keep one more envoy afield, and opens deeper court dealings.

tiers.description: A modest hall of dispatch. Two envoys may be kept afield at once. Petitions become possible, and one courtier may be sworn as the guild's Patron.
A standing diplomatic corps. Three envoys may be kept afield, the guild may keep a second Patron, and every parley opens with a fuller hand (5 cards).

A seat of true statecraft. Four envoys may be kept afield and a third Patron sworn. The guild may Broker the Compact with a Trusted court: a treaty for the rest of the timeline that Unites an archmage's Seat if the land is not too corrupted. And a doctrine, chartered at the Grand Hall. Patronage: two Patrons at one court. Or the Concordat: courts bound by the Compact send soldiers to your held lines.

doctrines.name: Patronage
doctrines.description: Depth at a few courts. A court may swear two Patrons to the guild, and the guild may keep one more Patron overall. Every Patron brings their own card to each parley in their kingdom, so a court with two backers puts two of their cards in your deck.

doctrines.name: The Concordat
doctrines.description: Breadth through allies. Every court the guild has brokered the Compact with sends soldiers to your Hold the Line postings: the front moves 3 more a moon per allied court (6 at most), on top of your party's own. A court never marches against itself.
